whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Vrindavan Kitchen,

I noticed your restaurant has strong 4.2★ reviews near Buddha Smriti Park on Frazer Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online table bookings and food inquiries.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, menu showcase, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/vrindavan

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Vrindavan Kitchen, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Vrindavan Kitchen) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with a clean digital menu, table booking, and easy directions from Buddha Smriti Park on Frazer Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
